releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.28 — Status is wired the way the reference does it: photo statuses (pick a picture, it uploads and posts as an image status), a real "viewed by" list with names and avatars on your own status, mute/unmute for a contact's updates, and your own photo in the My-status ring. Group Info now shows the server's actual member list instead of guessing it from your friend list, with admin controls to promote, demote and remove members, and delete the group.
